mapper.sql: id, definition_code, task_name, goal_template, scene_params, available_capability_types, constraint_description, completion_condition, is_preset, definition_status, created_at, updated_at, updated_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task_definitions ORDER BY is_preset DESC, id
